changes.text: L. Murugan resigned as Minister of State for Information & Broadcasting and Parliamentary Affairs.
Dharmendra Pradhan resigned as Education Minister; Pralhad Joshi given additional charge of Education.
Ravneet Singh Bittu resigned as Minister of State for Railways and Food Processing Industries.
George Kurian resigned as Minister of State for Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying and Minority Affairs.
